run_prompt_embed_inference: run a python script that sends prompt embeddings to a vLLM server via the OpenAI completions API
create_openai_client: create an OpenAI client connected to a local vLLM server at localhost port 8000
generate_prompt_embeddings: generate prompt embeddings from a chat message using a HuggingFace tokenizer and model
encode_tensor_to_base64: encode a PyTorch tensor of prompt embeddings into base64 format for API transmission
send_completion_with_embeds: send a completion request to vLLM with base64-encoded prompt embeddings via extra_body
